_comment: Repo-local config for the hybrid index. Everything here is a claim about
THIS repo, not about indexing in general — the tool's defaults live in
hybrid-code-index/hcindex.py::DEFAULT_CFG and know nothing about us.
Build-time exclusion is a last resort: it is unrecoverable without a full
rebuild, so it is reserved for content that is never an answer to any
query. Everything situational belongs on the command line via --exclude.
Each entry below has to earn its place with a measurement, recorded in

_exclude_rationale.*/outputs/*, */prompts/*: 173 run_NN.md-shaped near-duplicate model generations from haiku-assessment — an experiment's data, not its findings. They were 20% of the markdown corpus and were outranking real answers on identifier queries. Measured: excluding them moved keyword agreement 8/10 -> 10/10 with rediscovery unchanged at 5/5.
